draft.text: "From Token to Fleet" provides a systems-engineering breakdown of how LLM workloads transition from single-token inference to distributed execution across GPU fleets. It traces the concrete bottlenecks—memory throughput, kernel communication, and network saturation—without relying on software-layer abstractions. The result is a reference for engineers who need to diagnose and optimize performance at scale.
